scope: Build an exact frozen-universe Kraken-perpetual to Tardis Kraken-Spot mapping and download a bounded immutable raw pilot. No live-trading, canonical exit-policy, model, admission, or execution configuration was read for mutation or changed.

mapping.rule: only exact BASE/USD:USD perpetual -> BASE/USD spot, followed by exact membership in official Tardis Kraken Spot metadata; no aliases, quote conversions, or fuzzy matches

raw_pilot.transport: bounded direct Tardis dataset URL with 120-second request limit, gzip validation, SHA-256 receipt, and atomic promotion
raw_pilot.integrity: all nine promoted .csv.gz files passed gzip -t
raw_pilot.superseded_failures: Three initial optional snapshot_5 requests failed because the official datatype is book_snapshot_5. The manifest now guards per-symbol official datatypes and the replacement book_snapshot_5 manifest downloaded all three files.

correctness_repairs: Tardis integer timestamps are parsed as microseconds rather than Pandas default nanoseconds.
Compact state materialisation retains the final complete state per minute; it avoids per-tick depth/VWAP projections.
The complete book remains source-ordered, snapshot-reset, atomic by local timestamp, and unavailable before a valid snapshot.

commands: gzip -t on each nine raw pilot files
validation.result: 10 focused tests passed; compile and all gzip integrity checks passed
